AI Video Translator 1.0.0 — initial release

- Translate and dub video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) into any language with synced audio up to 500MB.
- Cloud-based processing with fast setup leveraging anonymous tokens for up to 100 free credits.
- Simple workflows for uploading, translating, and exporting videos in 1080p MP4.
- Integrated error handling for unsupported files, token issues, and exceeded size limits.
- Supports batch processing and iterative editing within a session.
- Automatic mapping of user prompts to cloud actions for seamless translation and rendering.
